title: TodayWeather for iOS · Usage analytics
scenario: Read whether usage analytics is on and change it from the side menu. Whether it starts on depends on the Region in iOS Settings (General > Language & Region): outside the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom and Switzerland it is on until you turn it off; there it stays off until you agree. The Korean screens come from the app's shell in a test on an iOS 26.5 simulator (402×874 pt), with no Firebase project.

steps.title: Find the row in Korea
steps.instruction: Open the side menu and scroll to the end. With the Region set to Korea, read 이용 통계 (Usage analytics).
steps.caption: The row reads 이용 통계 · 켜짐 (On): analytics is on because no choice has been made yet.
steps.expected: Ads, crash diagnostics and notifications are separate from this row.

steps.title: Turn analytics off
steps.instruction: Tap 이용 통계. The popup explains that analytics stays on unless you turn it off here. Tap 끄기 (Turn off).
steps.caption: 켜기 (Turn on) keeps it on and records that choice.
steps.expected: The popup closes and nothing more is collected.

steps.title: Confirm it is off
steps.caption: The row reads 이용 통계 · 꺼짐 (Off).
steps.expected: Your choice is kept on later starts until you change it here.

steps.title: Find the row in Germany
steps.instruction: With the Region set to Germany (or another EEA country, the United Kingdom or Switzerland), open the side menu and scroll to the end.
steps.caption: The row reads 이용 통계 · 꺼짐 (Off) until you agree.
steps.expected: Nothing is collected before you agree.

steps.title: Agree to analytics
steps.instruction: Tap 이용 통계. The popup asks for your consent. Tap 동의 (Agree), or 거부 / 철회 (Decline) to keep it off.
steps.caption: The same consent question as before this change.

steps.title: Confirm it is on
steps.caption: The row reads 이용 통계 · 켜짐 (On) after you agree.
steps.expected: You can withdraw at any time from the same row.
